news.title: WAFCON 2026 — Cameroon, Malawi clinch semifinal, FIFA World Cup spots on day of upsets
news.lede: Getty Images Getty Images https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/go1mwn/article71326901.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/toolxox.com-free-ai-tools-3k-WtoZzknVTR.jpg All four semifinalists qualify automatically for the tournament in Brazil, while Nigeria and the other losing quarterfinal teams play on Thursday with two spots in an intercontinental playoff tournament up for grabs. CASABLANCA Cameroon shocked defending champion Nigeria and Malawi stunned Ghana to reach the semifinals of the Women’s Africa Cup of Nations on Sunday and seal World Cup qualification. Cameroon goalkeeper Michaely Bihina excelled and her team held on as the 19-year-old Myriam Nyadjou’s early goal was enough for the Indomitable Lionesses’ 1-0 win over 10-time champion Nigeria. It is the first time that Nigeria has failed to reach the semifinals, where Cameroon will face host nation Morocco on Wednesday.

news.title: How Trabzonspor shocked Turkish rivals to make Mohamed Salah their Black Sea saviour
news.lede: Never before has a big name rejected Istanbul for Trabzon, but former Liverpool striker was offered more than riches. It began with a text sent during the World Cup. Ertugrul Dogan, the president of Trabzonspor, was watching Egypt when he picked up his phone and messaged his manager, Fatih Tekke. “Do you want Mohamed Salah?”

news.title: Haiya: Football transformation ‘on track’ after Malawi’s historic World Cup berth
news.lede: Football Association of Malawi (FAM) president Fleetwood Haiya has hailed the Scorchers’ historic qualification for the FIFA Women’s World Cup, declaring that the country’s football transformation is well and truly on track. Taking to Facebook following Malawi’s stunning 2-1 victory over Ghana in the Women’s Africa Cup of Nations quarter-finals, Haiya congratulated the team on securing the nation’s first ever appearance at football’s biggest stage. ‘Football Transformation is on track!’ ‘Congratulations to our Scorchers on securing Malawi’s first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup appearance.

news.title: Ghana knocked out of 2026 WAFCON quarter-finals by debutants Malawi
news.lede: The result also doubles as a historic qualification to the 2027 Women's World Cup for WAFCON debutants Malawi. Ghana and Malawi had previously faced off in a pre-tournament friendly just weeks prior with the Black Queens easily winning 4-0. However, it was always going to be a different encouter this time especially after the Scorchers topped Group C with Nigeria, Zambia, and Egypt. It was a dream start for Kim Lars Bjorkegren's women after Chantelle Boye Hlorkah volleyed home just 7 minutes into the game to give Ghana the lead after seven minutes.

news.title: Malawi stun Ghana to reach historic Women's AFCON semi-finals and seal first-ever World Cup place
news.lede: Malawi completed one of the greatest stories in the history of the TotalEnergies CAF Women's Africa Cup of Nations by defeating Ghana 2-1 on Sunday to secure a historic place in the semi-finals and qualify for the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 for the first time. A dramatic second-half winner from Rose Kadzere capped another unforgettable night for the tournament debutants, whose remarkable run continued after earlier victories over defending champions Nigeria and Egypt in the group stage. Having topped Group C on their maiden appearance, the Scorchers have now become one of only a handful of debutants to reach the semi-finals of the Women's AFCON, while simultaneously booking one of Africa's four automatic places at next year's FIFA Women's World Cup. For Ghana, the defeat was a bitter blow to their hopes of returning to the global finals for the first time since 2007.
